title: Comparison of the two dynamic assortment environments

Dataset populations, train/validation/test splits, and operating scenarios for the Expedia hotel-inventory and KuaiSearch-Lite product-exposure experiments. Expedia includes a fixed 30-hotel benchmark and destination markets grouped by historical search volume (Head, Regular, and Cold), while KuaiSearch includes search requests grouped by historical query frequency (Q-Head, Q-Regular, Q-Cold, and Q-Unseen).

Operating performance across the Expedia hotel-inventory and KuaiSearch product-exposure environments. Panel A reports daily revenue for Expedia30 and revenue per search for the Expedia destination-market groups. Panel B reports expected GMV per 1,000 requests for KuaiSearch, with product prices scaled by 1/100. Entries are means with standard deviations (SDs); bold values indicate the highest mean in each setting.

Operating performance of the A2C Transformer with frozen text encoders and LLM-guided S/R augmentation. Panel A reports daily revenue for Expedia30 and revenue per search for the Expedia market groups; Panel B reports expected GMV per 1,000 requests for KuaiSearch. A2C-Trans., Sent.-Trans., and mE5 denote A2C Transformer, Sentence-Transformer, and multilingual E5, respectively.
